mechanism: Time-series trend per asset (sign of 20/60/120-day returns) with inverse-volatility allocation across a fixed 10-coin universe, weekly rebalance, gross exposure <= 1
orthogonality: Profits from persistent moves in either direction across many coins, including bear trends (short side) and alt-specific trends; the closed survivors were long BTC only in calm external regimes. Legacy crypto_price_ta rejects were single-rule long/flat BTC; this is multi-asset, two-sided and risk-allocated.
weekend_coverage: Binance spot klines are 24/7; no signal vacuum.
universe_rule: Ten USDT spot pairs listed on Binance before 2019-06 and in the top 30 by market cap at 2019-12; frozen here. Survivorship note: none was delisted, which flatters results slightly.
